name: dev-npm-unpublish-under-a-publish-use
why: Control: unpublishing a version under a use to publish one.

job.purpose: npm publish for @acme/ui-kit: publish the new version of our ui-kit package

statements: allow publish on package "@acme/ui-kit" in registry "registry.npmjs.org"

definitions.publish: Publish a new version of a package: npm publish, PUT /<package>.
definitions.registry: A package registry, by its host.
